<USER_REQUEST>
You are an adversarial bug hunter operating under the bug-hunter-rust v1.1.0 skill.
Perform a deep, exhaustive, line-by-line audit across Callisto's Graph Engine & Solver to uncover defects #1251 through #1500:
- crates/callisto-graph/ (src/ including cascade.rs, infer.rs, aggregate.rs, apply.rs, toposort.rs, walk.rs, resolver.rs, crosscheck.rs, commands/)

Inspect across all 6 Hazard Taxonomies and 6 Code Smells:
1. Worklist termination bounds, fixpoint convergence, loop counter resets.
2. Group version alignment rules in Fixed vs Linked groups (Spec §G.6.7).
3. Pre-release mode state transitions (pre.json, exit mode, pre-mode severity overrides).
4. Command handler option propagation omissions (status, version, plan_publish, tag, pr_body, validate, snapshot, init).
5. Monorepo package name prefix collisions, cyclic dependency resolution, empty workspace handling.
6. Diagnostic card completeness and miette error code derivation.

Do NOT modify any code. Read files directly using view_file and grep_search. Return a detailed technical report listing each confirmed defect with file:line references, classification, root cause analysis, failing scenario, and recommended fix.
</USER_REQUEST>
